name: Resident Advisor
description: Resident Advisor (ra.co) electronic music and nightlife events worldwide, read from RA's own anonymous GraphQL API: resolve a city to its RA area, list events for an area and date range with genre and keyword filters, facets and pagination, read one event with lineup, venue and the public primary ticket tiers (price, booking fee, currency, sale status, on-sale window), search events, venues, artists, promoters, labels and areas by name, and read venue and artist profiles with their upcoming events. Read only: no purchases, holds or resale offers.

tools.name: Areas
tools.description: First step of event discovery: you need the numeric `area_id` for `events`, or the time zone and currency of a city.

options.name: country_code
options.about: RA country url code, e.g. `us`, `de`, `uk`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

options.name: query
options.about: City or region name to search, e.g. `berlin`, `new york`, `london`.

options.name: url_name
options.about: RA area url name, e.g. `newyorkcity`, `berlin`. Requires `country_code`. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,60}$.

response.about: Resolve a city or region to Resident Advisor areas: free-text search (`query`) or exact lookup by the area's url name and country code as they appear in `https://ra.co/events/{country}/{area}`. Returns each area's RA id, IANA time zone, country and currency, and the counts of listed events and venues.

fields.name: query
fields.about: The search text, or null for an exact lookup.

tools.name: Artist
tools.description: You have an artist id (from `search` or an event's `artists[].id`), an RA slug, or a pasted `https://ra.co/dj/{slug}` URL and need the profile or upcoming dates.

options.name: artist_id
options.about: RA artist id, e.g. `107433`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

options.name: events_limit
options.about: Upcoming events to include, default 20.

options.name: slug
options.about: RA artist url slug, e.g. `jamesaxon` (from `/dj/{slug}`). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,80}$.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted `https://ra.co/dj/{slug}` URL. Exactly one of `artist_id`, `slug` or `url`.

response.about: A Resident Advisor artist profile by numeric id or RA slug: name, image, status, follower and upcoming-event counts, links, country and home area, biography, and up to 20 upcoming events with venue and area time zone.

biography.blurb: Based in Los Angeles, James Axon is a musically studied and deep-digging DJ known for introducing dance floors to new sounds and new music, equally often through cutting-edge new releases as through the forgotten and obscure gems of the past.
biography.content:
James Axon is a DJ, musician, and creator of the LA-based queer underground party Planet Love, as well as a resident on Dublab with his radio show Hearing Color. A lifelong pianist turned obsessive record collector, James Axon approaches DJing as an extension of musicianship. Before falling into house and techno, he spent years in bands and orchestral ensembles, a background that still shapes the way he thinks about rhythm, harmony, and structuring his sets compositionally. 

As a keyboardist and musician, he has collaborated with Seven Davis Jr. and Massimiliano Pagliara, and as a DJ has shared lineups with the likes of Octo Octa, Eris Drew,  Avalon Emerson,The Blessed Madonna, Derrick Carter, Paramida, Peach, Moxie, Alex Kassian, Zombies in Miami, Jennifer Loveless, Sally C, Tornado Wallace, Perel, Eli Escobar, Paurro, and more. 

His sets drift seamlessly between house, techno, italo, electro, disco, and breaks, guided by an expansive taste shaped by pioneering artists like Aphex Twin, Kraftwerk, Giorgio Moroder, Jeff Mills, Laurent Garnier, Andrew Weatherall, and Francois Kevorkian. His sets are always colorful, eclectic, and intuitively reflective of the setting -- whether playing cosmic disco in an intimate loft or hypnotic techno in a dark foggy warehouse, he still finds a sound that is distinctly James Axon: melodic and synth-heavy, driving and dreamy.

tools.name: Event
tools.description: You have an RA event id (from `events`, `search`, `venue`, `artist`) or a pasted `https://ra.co/events/{id}` URL and need details or ticket prices and sale status.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted `https://ra.co/events/{id}` URL. Exactly one of `event_id` or `url`.

response.about: One Resident Advisor event: title, local date and times with IANA time zone, status, venue with address and coordinates, lineup, artists, genres, promoters, description, images, promotional links, and the public primary ticket tiers RA lists anonymously: title, retail price, booking fee, currency, sale status (`VALID` on sale, `NOTYETONSALE`, `NOLONGERONSALE`, `SOLDOUT`, ...), on-sale window, add-on flag, plus RA's `any_tier_available` snapshot. Prices are per ticket as RA states them; whether the service fee is included in the retail price is not exposed by the API and is reported as `fees: unknown`. Resale offers, allocation and remaining quantities need an RA login and are not covered. Availability is a snapshot, not a reservation.

fields.name: flyer_url
fields.about: First FLYERFRONT image or RA's legacy flyer field.

fields.name: lineup
fields.about: Lineup text as RA stores it; artist names may be wrapped in `<artist id="..">` tags.

fields.name: resale_active
fields.about: RA resale queue active for this event (resale offers themselves need a login).

fields.name: tickets
fields.about: Public primary ticket tiers RA returns for `tickets(queryType: AVAILABLE, ticketTierType: ALL)`. Empty for non-ticketed events and for events whose tiers RA no longer exposes.

fields.name: timezone
fields.about: IANA time zone of the event's area.

tools.name: Events
tools.description: Discover events by city and date; take `area_id` from `areas` and chain each `events[].id` into `event` for tickets.

options.name: area_id
options.about: RA area id from `areas` (8 New York City, 34 Berlin, 13 London, 1 Sydney). RA stores area ids as 16-bit integers.

options.name: date_from
options.about: First local listing date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today (UTC). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: date_to
options.about: Last local listing date, inclusive. Default: `date_from` + 7 days; at most 366 days after `date_from`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

options.name: genre
options.about: Genre slug from `facets.genres[].slug` (e.g. `techno`, `house`, `disco`). Pattern: ^[a-z0-9-]{1,40}$.

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page; use `next_page` from the previous response.

options.name: page_size
options.about: Rows per page, default 20.

options.name: query
options.about: Keyword matched against event titles within the area and window.

options.name: sort
options.about: `date`: RA's listing order (listing date, then relevance score, then title). `popularity`: most attending first. Default `date`.

response.about: Event listings for one RA area and a local date window (default: today and the next 7 days), page by page. Optional genre slug and title keyword filters, sort by date or by attendance. Each row carries the RA event id, local date and start/end times with the area's IANA time zone, venue, artists, genres, promoters, ticketed flag, promoter-entered display price and attendance counts; the response also carries genre and event-type facets for the window. Availability and structured ticket prices are in `event`.

fields.name: next_page
fields.about: Page number to request next, or null when exhausted.

fields.name: total_results
fields.about: Total listings RA reports for the filters.

tools.name: Search
tools.description: You know a name (artist, club, party, promoter, city) and need its RA id to chain into `event`, `venue`, `artist` or `events`.

options.name: limit
options.about: Maximum hits, default 16.

options.name: query
options.about: query

options.name: types
options.about: RA indices to search. Default: all six.

response.about: Resident Advisor global search across upcoming events, venues (clubs), artists, promoters, labels and areas by name. Each hit carries its RA id and type, the RA page URL, the area and country, and for events the local date and venue.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: You have a venue id (from `search`, `events[].venue.id`, or a pasted `https://ra.co/clubs/{id}` URL) and need the venue's details or its upcoming events.

options.name: events_limit
options.about: Upcoming events to include, default 20.

options.name: url
options.about: A pasted `https://ra.co/clubs/{id}` URL. Exactly one of `venue_id` or `url`.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: RA venue id, e.g. `71292`. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,12}$.

response.about: A Resident Advisor venue (club) profile: name, address, coordinates, website, capacity, closed flag, follower and event counts, area with IANA time zone and currency, and up to 20 upcoming events listed at the venue.

fields.name: capacity
fields.about: null when RA reports 0 or nothing.

fields.name: phone
fields.about: null when RA has an empty value.
